lens: LUCK AND MULTIPLE COMPARISONS (adversarial verifier, label verify-4-luck)
rule: 6 h trap guard (today 24 h) plus skip when the book page's own edge (ab_checkEv) is 1 point or more under the list's edge (ev); app universe: shown, ev>=2.5%, odds -200..+130, PROP/MONEYLINE/SPREAD, first listed within 24 h, book page read
numbers_reproduced: Matches the builder on every headline: 75 universe bets/28 games; rule keeps 39 bets/20 games (36 dropped), 17.29 a day over 2.256 days. CLV on bets with a close: kept 34 bets/18 games +3.30% [+2.03,+4.75] (close_ok 31/16 +3.33% [+2.04,+4.57]); universe 64/25 +1.38% [-0.04,+3.06]; dropped 30/17 -0.79% [-3.86,+1.92]. Lift kept-universe +1.91 pts, game-bootstrap CI [+0.62,+3.51]; kept-dropped +4.08 pts [+1.35,+7.53]. ROI kept -11.8% [-52.2,+38.3] on 38 settled (no confirmation by results). Raw one-sided p (rule vs the universe): 0.0032 random 34-of-64 subsets, 0.0040 shuffle within first-look day, 0.0052 within start day, 0.0031-0.0044 wild game-cluster sign flip, 0.0027 random game bundles; close_ok 0.0022-0.0078; matches the builder's 0.004/0.005. Halves by the shared date split (cut Oct 4): first 26 closes/14 games +2.94%, second 8 closes/4 games +4.46%; the builder's halves (3.62/3.12) do not reproduce.
reason: From the luck lens the combined rule is not distinguishable from luck once the tries are counted, and its two halves carry very unequal weight. (1) Raw p is about 0.003-0.008 on five nulls, but with the builder's 107 tries Bonferroni gives 0.29-0.47, and a max-over-family wild-cluster test gives p=0.09 (1,485 kept sets, >=34 closes), 0.24 (>=30), 0.88 (>=20); only narrower families give 0.02-0.05 (214 rules built on the 7 named signs; 6 h fixed plus one more flag). (2) The 6 h guard alone is only +1.18 pts over the universe (39 closes/20 games, p=0.092; long-vs-short +3.0 pts CI [-0.6,+7.3]); the 6 h cut has an independent prior (RESEARCH.md 71: Tj's own 176 bets, 3.6 SE, before the study), which is the real support, not this sample. (3) The falling-edge add-on is 5 dropped closes in 5 games in this universe (mean -2.45%, only 2 on close_ok), carried by one -9.3% Tracker bet (ex it: 4 closes, -0.74%, exact p=0.025 before any multiplicity); pooled over all page-read bets within 6 h it is 10 closes/42 games, +3.83 pts [+1.49,+5.57], p=0.002 raw, about 0.1-0.2 after counting ~57-107 alternative flags. (4) The contrast depends on the dropped tail: the three worst universe bets (-30.6%, -20.7%, -9.3%) are all dropped; without them the lift is +0.85 pts; the second-half 'confirmation' is 8 kept bets/4 games against 3 dropped bets, one of them -30.6% (exact p=0.048 on 11 closes). The kept side itself is not fragile (leave-one-game-out 3.07-4.05%; drop top-3 games +2.65% [+1.47,+4.10]; drop top-3 bets +2.77% [+1.69,+4.04]), the threshold sits on a plateau (kept 2.95-3.64% for gap cuts 0 to -3 pts), and the 6 h flag does separate on 172 other page-read bets in the same games (+1.73 pts [+0.69,+2.96]) but not on bets in games with no universe bet (38 closes/20 games, +0.12 pts [-1.9,+3.5], underpowered). Worth putting to Tj only as a question of whether to move the trap guard window from 24 h to 6 h (a prior-backed change), not as a validated two-part rule; the falling-edge half needs about 30 falling-edge closes in 25+ games (25 more, about 11-14 days at 2.2 a day) and the 6 h split about 35 games per arm if the true gap is 2 pts (about 15 if 3 pts; the flow is about 8 games a day an arm, so 2-5 more days).
caveats: Selection of closes: 27 of the 31 kept closes are Tracker closes ('read before the start, CNO's books': CNO's own consensus a few minutes before the start, only for bets Tj placed), 3 Novig trades, 1 Pinnacle. CLV here mostly measures whether CNO's consensus stayed put, not a sharp close; 69% of kept bets were placed by Tj vs 44% of dropped, so closes exist for different bet populations in the two arms.
Within Tracker closes the contrast still holds (kept +3.74% on 27 closes/14 games vs dropped -1.45% on 16/12), and listed fair drifted -0.44% on kept vs -4.45% on dropped.
The whole 75-bet universe (39 kept, 36 dropped) is props: no moneyline or spread bet is in it, so nothing here says anything about game lines.
Effective sample is 18 games kept, 4 games in the second half (5 in the half's universe); the three days of first looks (Oct 3-5) are one slice, with the app version and presets changing.

ab_checkEv was read a median 0.27 minutes after the first look but 11 of 75 were read more than 5 minutes later (max 904 min); 2 of the 13 falling-edge flags (both long-lead, dropped anyway by the 6 h cut) were read 279 and 350 minutes after the first look.

The wild-cluster null assumes symmetric game residuals; the data have a heavy left tail (-30.6%, -20.7%), so the family-max p-values are approximate; the within-day permutation ignores game clustering and is anti-conservative.

My families are my own construction (not the builder's actual 107 tries); the answer ranges from 0.02 to 0.88 depending on family size and minimum kept closes, so the multiplicity verdict is not sharp.
ROI at the first-listed price is -11.8% on the kept bets (38 settled, SE about 17 pts), +2.1% on the dropped: not informative either way, but not confirming.
Replication outside the universe uses the same games, so it is not independent; the only independent check (games with no universe bet) is underpowered and null.
Any change to which bets are placed (trap guard window, a falling-edge skip) is a question for Tj, not an action; the rule only tightens, it loosens no safety limit.

second_half.note: the 3 dropped closes are -30.6%, -3.3%, +5.6%; the -30.6% bet is a 613-minute-lead Tracker close
